messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content: Could you clarify which specific chess tournament you’re referring to? For example, were you asking about the World Chess Championship, the World Cup, or another event from 2015?
message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which chess tournament? Could refer to World Chess Championship 2015? That was held in 2015 between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin; Carlsen defended his title. So answer: Magnus Carlsen. But maybe they mean "World Chess Championship" or "FIDE World Cup"? The question is ambiguous. We need to ask clarifying question. According to policy, we should ask clarifying question if ambiguous. So respond asking which tournament.
